append.detail: Stage reveals now reach past the feed, from the unlock map (LIVE-668). My Quest: PageModules holds a module back until its stage floor (the Circle leaderboard waits for Regular). The right rail: the leaderboard panel waits for Regular as well as Crew standing. Your own profile: the Achievements grid waits until setup is done. Every read is fail-open and imports the progress spine on demand, so the shared layout graph does not grow. Defaults posted to the owner as a choice card; the map is a one-line retune.
